verdict.rationale: Marqeta's Core API documents webhooks as notifications about API events, sent as they occur to an endpoint hosted in your environment. This covers the core of subscribing to events. The Gateway JIT funding flow also pushes real-time funding requests to your system. missing for 10: documented subscription management (creating or filtering webhook subscriptions by event type), event catalog details, signature verification and retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
